concepts.def: Churchill's Fulton, Missouri speech describing Soviet barrier across Europe 'from Stettin to Trieste'.
Kennan's 1947 'Long Telegram' doctrine of resisting Soviet expansion without direct conflict; basis of Truman Doctrine.
North Atlantic Treaty Organization: 12 founding members in collective Western defence pact; Article 5 mutual assistance.
First hot proxy war: communist North invaded South, UN force under MacArthur, Chinese intervention, armistice at 38th parallel.
Polish trade union led by Lech Walesa from Gdansk shipyards; banned 1981 but undermined communist legitimacy.
Gorbachev's 1985+ openness and restructuring policies; unintentionally accelerated Soviet collapse 1989-91.
